newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU jobless rate slips to 10.7 pct in June/July.
newsitem.headline: EU jobless rate slips to 10.7 pct in June/July.

text.p: Unemployment in the European Union edged down to 10.7 percent in June and July from 10.8 percent in the prior two months, Eurostat, the EU's statistical office said on Monday.
With 17.9 million people out of work in the bloc's 15 member states, the latest report offered a mixed picture on employment conditions within the EU.
While the rate of joblessness has been falling steadily over the past two years in countries such as Denmark, Spain, Britain and Finland, it has been noticebably higher in Germany and France.
Luxembourg continued to put in the best employment performance with an unemployment rate at 3.1 percent, while Spain held on to the highest jobless rate at 21.3 percent.
